allow: Shell(where java; dir "C:\Program Files\Apache" 2>nul; dir "%USERPROFILE%\.m2" 2>nul; where mvnw 2>nul)
Shell(where javac 2>nul & set JAVA_HOME & set MAVEN_HOME & dir /s /b "C:\Program Files\Java" 2>nul & dir "C:\Program Files\Microsoft VS Code" 2>nul | findstr /i java)
Shell(where mvn 2>nul & where mvn.cmd 2>nul & dir /s /b "C:\" 2>nul | findstr /i "apache-maven maven\bin\mvn.cmd mvn.cmd" 2>nul | findstr /v /i "git vscode")
Shell(where choco 2>nul & where scoop 2>nul & where winget 2>nul & where gradle 2>nul & echo --- & echo %PATH%)
